title: Episode 2 - Chulbul ki topi
end_card:
पार्ट 3 कल!
दिवाली में 9 दिन बाकी

shots.visual: Dawn in the market square. Every single diya from the lamp stall has vanished, only empty clay trays remain. On the ground lies a small brown newsboy cap. Chikki holds it up between two fingers with her eyebrow raised. Chulbul stares at the cap with wide eyes, sweating.
shots.camera: slow pan across the empty trays, ending on Chikki holding up the cap

lines.speaker: chikki
lines.hi: एक भी दिया नहीं बचा! और ये टोपी चुलबुल, तेरी है!

lines.speaker: chulbul
lines.hi: मेरी? नहीं! ये मेरी जुड़वाँ टोपी है!

shots.visual: Chikki clips a tiny pair of handcuffs onto Chulbul's tail. Chulbul wriggles and squeaks. Bhola watches in terror, hands on his cheeks. Kallu watches from a roof edge, delighted, rubbing his wings together.
shots.camera: medium shot on Chikki and Chulbul, then cut to Bhola's scared face, then Kallu's smirk

lines.speaker: bhola
lines.hi: हाय राम! अब चुलबुल भी चोर?

shots.visual: Chikki sniffs the cap and turns it over with her magnifying glass: tiny golden shimmering dust sticks to the lining. She looks up, serious. Behind her Chulbul slips out of the handcuffs, guilty-looking, and quickly licks a golden crumb off his paw.
shots.camera: extreme close-up on the golden dust under the magnifying glass, then pull back to Chikki

lines.speaker: chikki
lines.hi: टोपी पर सोने की धूल? चोर की नज़र किसी बड़ी चीज़ पर है!

shots.visual: Cliffhanger. Chikki finds a folded note tucked in the cap lining and unfolds it. Everyone leans in. A dramatic close-up of the note, then Bhola faints backward with a thud. Kallu on the roof whispers to himself with a sly grin.
shots.camera: close-up on the note in Chikki's paws, then wide shot as Bhola faints, then Kallu's grin

lines.speaker: chikki
lines.hi: सोने का लड्डू! अगला निशाना वही है!
